verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring payments or workflows is a fair question for a business payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no scheduled or recurring transfer, job, or workflow capability. Batch groups, bulk settlement at the end of a settlement period, and webhook subscriptions are adjacent one-off or event-driven features, not user-defined recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
